chunks: And from him, and from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, and from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from a man, from Abbas ibn al-Walid, from his father, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever hates Hasan and Husayn will come on the Day of Judgment with no flesh on his face, and my intercession will not reach him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of hating Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the theological weight of *al-wala'* and *al-baraa'* (loyalty and enmity) by linking hatred of the Ahl al-Bayt to a unique physical manifestation of spiritual decay on the Day of Judgment. The absence of flesh on the face signifies the loss of the 'light' of prophethood, serving as a direct barrier to the Prophet's intercession (*shafa'ah*), a concept central to Shia eschatology.
